form.label: Daily & Monthly Trend
form.description: Daily and monthly license consumption trends, with a detailed daily table (by license pool) flagging days that came close to or exceeded quota. The detail table is sourced from Splunk's own RolloverSummary events - the authoritative record written once each license day closes - so it reflects the quota that was actually in effect on each day, not today's quota applied retroactively.

search.query: `license_usage_base` | `license_usage_gb` | timechart span=1d sum(GB) as GB | trendline sma7(GB) as "7-day avg"

panel.title: Daily Detail vs. Quota by License Pool

search.query: `license_rollover_base` | `license_rollover_gb` | eval PctOfQuota=round((GB/QuotaGB)*100,1) | eval Status=case(PctOfQuota>=100,"over quota",PctOfQuota>=90,"near quota",1=1,"normal") | eval Date=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d") | rename pool as Pool | sort -Date, Pool | table Date Pool GB QuotaGB PctOfQuota Status
